author: Pigbeard_Pete
body:
Just a second ago, AussiePinger asked me to screenshot his defense for a public match.

He seemed to be very proud of it :)





It was very nice in terms of disguising the monument with other obsidian, and he was just about to complete the floor before the match ended.
Here you go Aussie! <3
(photos taken by me)
